name: ground-outbound-in-buying-signals
description: A sales lead asks agents to ground outbound personalization in verified account signals.

judgment.statement: Personalize outbound with verified account signals. When no buying signal is established, use a neutral introduction rather than inventing urgency or intent.
judgment.rationale: Fabricated buying intent undermines trust and creates repeated review work.

limits: Does not authorize sending an email or override outreach permissions.
Reassess when new account evidence establishes an actual buying signal.

evidence.summary: Explicit synthetic sales guidance, not a measured outcome.
